_comment: Areas that are reachable in the legacy application but must not be ported. Consumed by scripts/analyze-controllers.php, which moves these out of the port list and into the skip list.

controllers.frenchController: French is no longer a supported language.
controllers.InitiativesFrenchController: French is no longer a supported language.
controllers.NewsFrenchController: French is no longer a supported language.
controllers.SuccessFrenchController: French is no longer a supported language.
controllers.TestimoniesFrenchController: French is no longer a supported language.
controllers.RegisterController: Cannot run: declares neither create() nor validator() for the RegistersUsers trait, references Admin and Trainee models that do not exist, and requires guards that are not configured. Authentication is being rebuilt.

StudyController._reason: The study-zone student and visit-entry tracking approach has been retired and is not being carried into the new application. The /admin/study and /admin/study/successes areas of this controller are unaffected and still port.

notes.StudyController::index: Mixed screen. It returns new.admin.study.index with study-zone initiatives (iniStudy, iniPending, sucstudy, sucpending) alongside student data (students, students_count, studentsentry_count and fifteen per-centre visit-count queries). Port the initiative half only; drop the student half.
notes.routes: Fifteen routes under /admin/student/* and /admin/studententry/* are retired with these methods, plus /admin/study/studentsjson and /admin/study/studentsentryjson.
notes.students_index: Routed at routes/web.php:293 but the method does not exist in StudyController, so /admin/student/index already returns a 500. Retired either way.
notes.database: The students and student_entries tables are left untouched in the database, as with the French tables. Nothing here changes the schema.
